CD47 acts as a "don't eat me" signal by binding to signal regulatory protein alpha (SIRPα),suppressing immune activation. While this axis has been well characterized in macrophages, its influence on NK cell-mediated xenograft rejection remains unclear. We investigated whether expression of human CD47 (hCD47) on porcine aortic endothelial cells (PAECs) from transgenic pigs inhibits human NK activity. seleccion.titulo: Kidney xenotransplantation as an investigational rescue strategy: a clinical perspective on high-KDPI kidney allograft as a comparator
seleccion.resumen_previo: Revisión clínica que documenta el progreso hacia aplicaciones clínicas del xenotrasplante renal con riñones porcinos modificados que han proporcionado función independiente de diálisis en pacientes vivos por períodos sostenidos. Evalúa la viabilidad del xenotrasplante como solución a la escasez de órganos.
seleccion.extracto: Kidney transplantation is the gold standard treatment for end-stage kidney disease. Despite increasing transplant case volume in recent years, its access is limited due to a donor organ shortage, resulting in significant waitlist mortality. Xenotransplantation has the potential to address this unmet need and has made significant progress from early, largely unsuccessful nonhuman-primate experiments in the 1960s to early clinical application in the 2020s: genetically modified pig kidneys have now provided dialysis-independent function in a few living human recipients, sustained for months in so

seleccion.titulo: Neo-ureter reconstruction using tubularized bladder urothelium to salvage a shortened ureter in a non-human primate kidney transplant model
seleccion.resumen_previo: Se desarrolló una técnica quirúrgica innovadora en un modelo de trasplante renal en primates no humanos para reconstruir el uréter mediante tejido urotelial de vejiga tubularizado. Este abordaje salvaguarda trasplantes con uréteres acortados, un problema común en estos modelos experimentales que limita la reparación convencional.
seleccion.extracto: Ureteral complications are the most common urological adverse events after renal transplantation, and ischemia of the distal graft ureter is the usual cause of urine leak. Salvage is especially difficult in non-human primate (NHP) transplant models, where the recipient bladder is small and the graft ureter short. We report an NHP that developed a urine leak from a graft-to-native uretero-ureterostomy after renal transplantation. seleccion.titulo: Mechanomedicine for Lung Transplantation: From Multiscale Forces to AI-Assisted Translation

seleccion.extracto: Long-term outcomes after lung transplantation remain limited by primary graft dysfunction and chronic lung allograft dysfunction, despite improvements in surgery, immunosuppression and infection control. Mechanical injury is a complementary contributor that remains insufficiently integrated into transplant care. The lung allograft must accommodate cyclic ventilation, reperfusion shear, thoracic constraints and matrix remodeling. seleccion.extracto: The liver combines continuous exposure to gut-derived antigens and metabolites with immune surveillance and tissue repair. Its immune niche is organized by interactions among sinusoidal endothelial cells, Kupffer cells, recruited leukocytes, and parenchymal and stromal cells. At homeostasis, these interactions support antigen clearance and restrained immune activation. seleccion.titulo: What's Hot and What's New in Xenotransplantation From the Young Investigator Committee of the IXA–Clinical Science

seleccion.extracto: Streptococcus suis is an important swine pathogen with numerous serotypes, and different serotypes vary considerably in population structure, pathogenicity, and antimicrobial resistance. Serotype 16 is one of the serotypes reported to infect humans, yet its population structure, pathogenic potential, and resistance characteristics remain poorly understood. Here, we analyzed 303 serotype 16 strains from 13 countries and found high genetic diversity, clear geographical clustering, and three distinct phylogenetic groups. El trabajo sintetiza cómo la edición CRISPR, la inmunomodulación y los modelos in vitro relevantes para humanos pueden combinarse como una plataforma biotecnológica coherente para trasplante de órganos.
seleccion.extracto: Xenotransplantation is moving from isolated proof-of-concept procedures toward an engineered biotechnology platform for organ replacement. This review examines how genome-designed donor pigs, recipient-directed immunopharmacology, human-relevant in vitro testbeds, and data-driven decision systems can be integrated to address the remaining barriers to clinical translation. Los cerdos triple-knockout carecen de los tres principal xenoantígenos, lo que reaviva el interés clínico en esta modalidad alternativa de transfusión.
